title: Effect of Nanoparticle Size and Concentration on Pool Boiling Heat Transfer with TiO2 Nanofluids on Laser-Textured Copper Surfaces
reason: The authors performed their own pool boiling experiments with TiO2-water nanofluids on laser-textured copper surfaces, reporting measured boiling curves, HTC and CHF values (e.g., "The highest CHF of 1457 kW m-2 was recorded at 0.1 wt.%").
